explainer_content.short_definition: The Southern guitar-rock road where blues, country, boogie, jam interplay, and regional identity meet arena-scale hooks.
explainer_content.history_capsule: The Allman Brothers Band, Lynyrd Skynyrd, ZZ Top, Marshall Tucker Band, and related artists made Southern rock broad enough to include improvisational jams, hard anthems, roadhouse boogie, and rootsy storytelling.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It gave classic rock a regional voice and created a route from blues/country roots to jam-band culture and arena standards.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The guitars often converse rather than simply stack. Even the big anthems carry bar-band, blues, or country traces.
what_to_listen_for: Long live solos or call-and-response jams
